headline: Solana Activates Alpenglow Network Upgrade to Improve Finality
summary: Solana has launched its Alpenglow network upgrade, replacing its voting system to target roughly 150-millisecond transaction finality.
why: Solana is a high-throughput blockchain platform competing with Ethereum for decentralized finance and application hosting.

impacts.name: Solana
impacts.why: Major protocol upgrades alter network performance parameters, though immediate price direction depends on broader market conditions.
